import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True) if df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any() else np.nan

    # Totals
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if pd.notna(rev_ly) and rev_ly:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(df["Units_TW"].sum(), 2), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", num(df["Units_LW"].sum(), 2), "sum(Units_LW)")
    if df["Units_LW"].sum():
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW",
            num((df["Units_TW"].sum() - df["Units_LW"].sum()) / df["Units_LW"].sum() * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(df["Orders_TW"].sum(), 2), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if df["Orders_LW"].sum():
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW",
            num((df["Orders_TW"].sum() - df["Orders_LW"].sum()) / df["Orders_LW"].sum() * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)

    # Top entities by revenue
    for _, r in d.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this entity")
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW",
            num(r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    if len(d):
        add(d.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(d.iloc[0]["Rank"], 2), "Rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")
        top3 = d.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum()
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top3 / rev_tw * 100, 1) if rev_tw else 0.0,
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # WoW movers by percent
    w = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if len(w):
        up = w.loc[w["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
        dn = w.loc[w["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(up["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(up["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest gain)")
        add(dn["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(dn["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest drop)")

    # WoW movers by absolute GBP change
    a = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if len(a):
        a["delta"] = a["Revenue_TW"] - a["Revenue_LW"]
        gain = a.loc[a["delta"].idxmax()]
        loss = a.loc[a["delta"].idxmin()]
        add(gain["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(gain["delta"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute gain)")
        add(loss["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(loss["delta"]),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW (largest absolute decline)")

    # YoY movers
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if len(y):
        yu = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        yd = y.loc[y["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(yu["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(yu["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest gain)")
        add(yd["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(yd["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest drop)")

    # Units and orders leaders
    u = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(u):
        ul = u.loc[u["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ul["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(ul["Units_TW"], 2), "max(Units_TW) across entities")
    o = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(o):
        ol = o.loc[o["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(ol["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(ol["Orders_TW"], 2), "max(Orders_TW) across entities")

    # Units WoW for top entity
    if len(d):
        t = d.iloc[0]
        if pd.notna(t["Units_LW"]) and t["Units_LW"]:
            add(t["Entity"], "units", "WoW", num((t["Units_TW"] - t["Units_LW"]) / t["Units_LW"] * 100, 1),
                "(Units_TW - Units_LW) / Units_LW * 100")
        if pd.notna(t["Orders_LW"]) and t["Orders_LW"]:
            add(t["Entity"], "orders", "WoW", num((t["Orders_TW"] - t["Orders_LW"]) / t["Orders_LW"] * 100, 1),
                "(Orders_TW - Orders_LW) / Orders_LW * 100")

    # Smallest contributor
    if len(d) > 1:
        b = d.iloc[-1]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(b["Revenue_TW"]), "min(Revenue_TW) across entities")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
